;Disasters and accidents
*[[Typhoon Faxai (2019)|Typhoon Faxai]] kills three people and causes damage to [[Japan]]'s capital [[Tokyo]]. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2019/09/09/national/typhoon-faxai/ (''The Japan Times'')]

;International relations
*[[Nuclear program of Saudi Arabia]]
**Saudi Arabia says it experiments with two [[nuclear reactor]]s and wants to go ahead with the "full [[nuclear cycle]]", implying also [[Enriched uranium#Enrichment methods|uranium enrichment]]. The United States states they would like to pursue a [[Section 123 Agreement]] to accompany the transfer of U.S. technology. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-energy-wec-saudi-nuclearpower/saudi-arabia-wants-to-enrich-uranium-for-nuclear-power-minister-idUSKCN1VU168 (Reuters)]
*The [[International Monetary Fund]] confirms that [[Kristalina Georgieva]] is the only candidate for the nomination as its Managing Director. [https://www.politico.eu/article/georgieva-in-one-horse-race-for-imf-top-job/ (Politico.eu)]

;Law and crime
*[[2019 Samoa assassination plot]]
**Three suspects appear in court in [[Apia]], [[Samoa]], where two of them enter not-guilty pleas and the other a guilty plea on charges of conspiracy to assassinate the Prime Minister of Samoa. The defendant who pleaded guilty is due to be sentenced on September 30. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/398399/man-pleads-guilty-to-conspiring-to-assassinate-samoa-pm (RNZ)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Tuvaluan general election]]
**Citizens of [[Tuvalu]] head to the polls to elect the 15 members of the [[Parliament of Tuvalu|parliament]]. [https://www.facebook.com/fenuinews/photos/a.459192167575297/1491829800978190/ (Fenui News)]
*[[Politics of the United Kingdom]]
**[[John Bercow]] announces his resignation as [[Speaker of the House of Commons (United Kingdom)|Speaker of the House of Commons]], effective October 31. [https://www.irishtimes.com/news/world/uk/bercow-to-stand-down-as-commons-speaker-at-end-of-october-1.4012412 (''The Irish Times'')]
*[[Women's rights in Iran]]
**An [[Iran]]ian female football fan, [[Sahar Khodayari]], dies one week after setting herself on fire outside a [[Judicial system of Iran|court]], reportedly after learning she may have to serve a six-month sentence for trying to [[Women's rights in Iran#Sports|enter a football stadium alongside men]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/iranian-female-soccer-fan-dies-after-setting-herself-on-fire/2019/09/10/8b4a7d30-d3a9-11e9-8924-1db7dac797fb_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
